name: CI and Auto Merge for imgcompress

on:
  # Feature branches run through pull_request only. Pushing them here as well
  # started every PR run twice.
  push:
    branches:
      - main
      - next_rc
      - release/*
  pull_request:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      upload_feature_flags_artifacts:
        description: "Upload feature-flags matrix screenshots / videos artifact? (default on)"
        required: false
        default: "true"
      deploy_nightly:
        description: "After E2E tests succeed, trigger the nightly deployment workflow"
        type: boolean
        required: false
        default: false

permissions:
  contents: read

# Cancel superseded runs on the same PR / branch so we don't waste minutes
# building stale commits and so auto-merge always acts on the latest CI.
# Every commit on main keeps its run.
concurrency:
  group: ci-auto-merge-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.ref != 'refs/heads/main' }}

jobs:
  # Job names below are what shows up as checks on a PR. `ci-status` at the end
  # needs every test job, so it is the one check to require for merging.
  #
  # Cache: each GHA cache scope has exactly one writer (test-e2e for the app
  # image, test-backend for the dev container). Every other job only reads it.
  # Seven jobs exporting the same scope at once mostly raced each other.
  #
  # QEMU is only set up where an arm64 image is built. The amd64 jobs don't need
  # it, and eight jobs saving the same binfmt cache key produced the
  # "Unable to reserve cache ... another job may be creating this cache" noise.

  lint-python:
    name: lint Python
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - name: Check out code
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@6d4fd22b20465ccc0f7354476588e8df7c9ca0e0 # v7
        with:
          python-version: "3.11"

      - name: Install Ruff
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          python -m pip install ruff==0.15.14

      - name: Run Ruff
        run: ruff check backend tests healthcheck.py update_dockerhub_description.py

  scan-image:
    name: scan local image
    needs: lint-python
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - name: Check out code
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Set up Docker Buildx
        uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@f87e5991a6d7451dcb8d9637bfbc97413f497069 # v4

      - name: Authenticate to dhi.io for DHI base images
        if: github.event_name != 'pull_request' || github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository
        env:
          REGISTRY_USERNAME: ${{ vars.DOCKERHUB_USERNAME }}
          REGISTRY_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.GITHUBACTIONS_DOCKERHUB_PULL_TOKEN || secrets.DOCKERHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: ./scripts/dockerLoginWithRetry.sh dhi.io

      - name: Build local application image
        uses: ./.github/actions/docker-build
        with:
          context: .
          platform: linux/amd64
          tags: karimz1/imgcompress:local-scan
          cache-scope: app-linux/amd64

name: Checks

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      # submodules: the SoloPlay submodule cannot be checked in isolation (its tsconfig points at
      # ../../sdk and ../../libs), so the parent checkout is where it gets validated - against the
      # exact commit this repo pins.
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      # Node 24: eslint-plugin-es-x@10 requires ^22.23.0 || ^24.18.0 || >=26.4.0, and
      # eslint@10 requires ^20.19.0 || ^22.13.0 || >=24. Anything older cannot run the toolchain.
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      # lint:check, never `lint` - that one is `eslint --fix`, which would rewrite files in CI
      # and let anything auto-fixable pass silently.
      - name: ESLint
        run: npm run lint:check

      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck

      # The no-undef inventory is generated. If someone adds a global without regenerating,
      # the committed file goes stale and no-undef quietly stops covering it.
      - name: Globals inventory is current
        run: npm run globals:check

      - name: Typecheck (SoloPlay submodule)
        run: npm run typecheck:soloplay

      # Every runtime .js must belong to a TS program. A file in none gets no typechecking and
      # no editor intellisense, and nothing else reports it.
      - name: No orphaned files
        run: node tools/audit/program-files.mjs --check
